name: Tobias Kafka
source: A mysterious young man who appears at your shop covered in wounds. He does not talk much with others and tends to do everything by himself. Although he makes himself hard to approach, he is kind at heart and makes sure that you stay out of danger. He is skilled, as well as knowledgable in magic.
